Market today: Bond yields are spiking, hitting 2007 highs. This is a major headwind for growth stocks like your tech/chip names, as it makes future earnings less valuable and borrowing more expensive. Nvidia's AI moat is also shifting, which is a long-term watch for your chip concentration.

Your holdings: SOXL (-40.46%) and SPAL (-39.68%) are both leveraged ETFs showing deep losses and flagged for attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 30-year Treasury yield; continued increases will pressure your tech-heavy book. Also, the scanner is flagging QQQ for a potential add.

Bottom line: Risk management on your leveraged positions is critical right now, especially with rising rates.
plays: Re-evaluate your stops on SOXL (-40.46%) and SPAL (-39.68%) given their leveraged nature and significant drawdowns; consider trimming to reduce margin exposure.
The scanner flags QQQ (2.13%) for accumulation around 729.14-728.41 with a stop at 727.23. Consider adding if it hits this range.
